data.turoyo: Mədle l ʕAli l droʕa, mšantrole,
data.translation: Da packte Ali sie am Arm, schleuderte sie wütend auf die Erde

rationale: Thin Preterit sense-1 cell: first fully contextualized textual example alongside the inherited bare form.

summary: The overt l-marked agent Ali is resumed by the Preterit ending; the female patient is incorporated in mšantrole. The preceding arm-grasping clause makes the object recoverable.
Retain the glossary's stem I label for this quadriliteral. The token confirms the existing throwing/flinging sense, without an additional construction or idiom.
The German supplies anger and direction to the ground; these are retained as the edition's contextual translation, not added to the core lexical gloss.
Confirm the segmentation of mšantrole's patient and agent endings against the entry's base mšantalle; the attested spelling is retained.
